knownLimitations: Current-source Android and desktop artifacts are built and installed locally only; they are not hosted or production signed. Current-source iOS Simulator build/install/cold-launch/callback is verified on GitHub Actions, but the artifact is unsigned, ephemeral and not a physical-device, TestFlight or App Store proof. Historical 0.2.0 artifacts do not include the Internet Bridge.
No provider credential, verified sender domain, DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC evidence, public webhook, reputation proof or sandbox delivery evidence is present.
Central Wallet registry/verifier and AI POST route are not merged or deployed.
No production signing, persistent staging Web/API, public product URL or store release.
Message bodies and attachments are authenticated against state tamper but are not end-to-end encrypted.
The self-contained backup includes the state HMAC key and sender identity key and therefore requires an approved encrypted operator backup boundary; it is not a hostile-storage authenticity proof.
Legacy state forward loading is verified, but prior strict-decoder binaries reject the new Data Fabric fields; a versioned rollback export and exact old-binary drill remain incomplete.
The Mail-owned Data Fabric outbox is locally implemented and tested, but authenticated central transport, schema acceptance, billing mapping and central replay handling are not integrated.
Malware scanning, operator unsuppression with central RBAC, active provider health polling and Monitor alerts remain incomplete.
